uncertainties: Reviewed M5 Ultra official sources do not state die-interconnect bandwidth or latency, cache topology, or cross-die access cost.
No older Ultra interconnect specification is carried forward or synthesized by multiplying Max specifications.
Detailed throughput for a precision/shape/kernel is not established by product core counts or peak bandwidth.
Hardware capability and documented APIs do not establish any particular inference engine's kernel selection or model compatibility.
